Step.Text: PURPOSE: Build the GenericSearch config for the Vehicles pane of the Client/Vehicle picker and dispatch it. Owned vehicles sort to the top; scope="owned" filters to the selected client only. Results return to JS receiveVehicleData on the clientvehiclepicker web viewer.

Step.name: Insert Text
Step.Text: PARAMETER (JSON): offset, limit, search, clientId, scope (owned|all)

Value.Calculation: "CASE WHEN ForeignKeyClient = '" & Substitute ( $clientId ; "'" ; "''" ) & "' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, Manufacturer ASC, Model ASC"
